description: If \(A\in C\sigma\) and \(\neg A\in D\tau\) for ground substitutions, one admissible generalized inference on \(C,D\), selecting exactly the full pivot fibers in their fresh copies, has a resolvent \(E\) and ground \(\rho\) with \(E\rho=(C\sigma\setminus\{A\})\cup(D\tau\setminus\{\neg A\})\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderResolution.one_step_lifting.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  (C D : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.FOClause L ℕ)
  (σ τ : ℕ → Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.GroundTerm L)
  (p : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.GroundAtom L)
  (hp : Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.pos p ∈ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.clauseSubst σ C)
  (hn : Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.neg p ∈ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.clauseSubst τ D) :
  ∃ d,
    d.positiveFamily =
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderResolution.pivotFiber
          (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderResolution.combine σ τ)
          (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderResolution.leftCopy C) (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.pos p) ∧
      d.negativeFamily =
          Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderResolution.pivotFiber
            (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderResolution.combine σ τ)
            (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderResolution.rightCopy D) (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.neg p) ∧
        ∃ ρ,
          Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.clauseSubst ρ
              (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderResolution.resolvent d) =
            Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.resolvent p (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.clauseSubst σ C)
              (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.clauseSubst τ D)
